hypothesis: With the India VIX dataset restored, EXP-0013 through EXP-0017 also reproduce exactly, completing the audit begun in EXP-0018 and resolving the two questions that could not be settled without the data: the 6x conflict in EXP-0016's recorded results, and whether the step-down drawdown multiplier scales the lot cap or the capital term.
dataset_version: nifty-5min-2023-2025 sha256 830bd8bb6f70d1b4… + india_vix_daily-2023-2025 sha256 ddb209c300682272…, both re-fetched 2026-10-13 and recorded in data/live_data/CHECKSUMS.json
method: The India VIX file was believed to require a manual NSE download; it is in fact available from the Upstox Analytics API under instrument key 'NSE_INDEX|India VIX' and is now fetched by scripts/data_002_fetch_vix.py. 744 rows, matching the NIFTY dataset's 744 trading sessions exactly, with verify_data.py's VIX-covers-NIFTY cross-check passing. All five VIX-dependent experiments were then re-run and compared against their committed records.

FINDING-1.title: The EXP-0016 6x conflict is resolved: ₹10 lakh is correct, the ASTRA_STATUS table is wrong
FINDING-1.detail: EXP-0016 reproduces at ₹1,004,178 net after tax for the ₹50k / 20-lot scenario — approximately ₹10 lakh. This confirms the figure recorded in HANDOFF.md and ASTRA_STATUS.md line 89, and refutes the ASTRA_STATUS.md capital-goal table, which claimed ₹88,48,311 gross / ~₹60 lakh after tax for the same scenario. The table's scenario list is also wrong: the script's third scenario is ₹20k at 25 lots (reproducing at ₹1,014,682), not ₹20k at 50 lots. The reconstructed EXP-0016.json recorded both claims without choosing between them; this experiment chooses.
FINDING-1.confidence: HIGH — reproduced from the committed script against checksummed data

FINDING-2.title: The drawdown multiplier scales the lot cap, not the capital term — all three documents are wrong
FINDING-2.detail: Confirmed by reading exp_0017_drawdown_management.py directly: `eff_max = max(1, int(base_max_lots * mult))`, then `lots = min(lots_from_cap, eff_max)`. The reproduced D_steps monthly log confirms the effective caps at a base of 20: 1.00x→20, 0.65x→13, 0.35x→7, 0.12x→2. CLAUDE.md, HANDOFF.md and ASTRA_STATUS.md all write the multiplier against the capital term, a form which clamps to the unscaled cap and cannot produce the 7-lot figure EXP-0017 itself records. All three have been corrected. See DECISION-008.
FINDING-2.confidence: HIGH — read from source and confirmed against reproduced output

FINDING-3.title: The validated compounding engine spends profitable months artificially throttled
FINDING-3.detail: EXP-0017 marks the high-water mark per trade on capital that has not yet had the month's tax withheld. At month close 30% of the month's profit moves to the tax reserve, net capital falls below that peak, and the engine registers a drawdown it never suffered. The reproduced D_steps log shows 2023-03 posting +₹116,587 while sitting at the 0.65x tier, and 2023-05 posting +₹509,869 while sitting at the 0.35x defense tier with a cap of 7 lots. This mechanism accounts for much of the '16 of 34 months in reduced mode' figure. The ₹49.2L result was therefore achieved despite the engine being throttled through most of 2023-24, not because the throttling helped.
FINDING-3.confidence: HIGH — mechanism read from source, effect visible in the reproduced monthly log
FINDING-3.implication: Proposed EXP-0020 should quantify the cost by re-running D_steps with month-close HWM marking, or with the tax reserve accrued per trade so net capital is always post-tax. If material, the drawdown response needs redesigning before paper trading. This is a position-sizing change and requires approval under AGENTS.md section 13.

FINDING-4.title: The India VIX file never needed to be sourced manually
FINDING-4.detail: HANDOFF.md section 7 listed it as an NSE download with no fetcher in the repo, which is why EXP-0013..0017 had been unreproducible. Upstox serves it under 'NSE_INDEX|India VIX' — the only accepted spelling, as INDIA VIX, India Vix and INDIAVIX all return 400 Invalid Instrument key. The whole 3-year range returns in one daily-interval call, since the 30-day limit applies only to intraday intervals. DATA-002 now automates it.

conclusion: HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. All five VIX-dependent experiments reproduce exactly, bringing the audit to 9 of 9 for EXP-0009 through EXP-0017. Both 2023-2025 datasets are now fetchable from Upstox by committed scripts, verified by 11 integrity checks plus a cross-dataset alignment check, and checksummed. RISK-0 is fully resolved and RISK-6 is resolved in favour of the ₹10 lakh figure. The research core of ASTRA is reproducible from a clean clone for the first time. Two substantive findings came out of the audit rather than the reproduction: the sizing formula in every document is wrong (FINDING-2, now corrected), and the validated compounding engine throttles itself after profitable months through a tax-withholding artifact (FINDING-3, which is a live design question, not a documentation one). Reproducibility remains distinct from validity: these experiments reproduce their own numbers, which says nothing about the open risk-limit conflict in DECISION-010, the post-hoc sizing assumption in G1, or the multiple-testing exposure that EXP-0010's own record flags.
caveats: CAVEAT-1: Equivalence of the re-fetched datasets is inferred from identical results, not proven by hash; the originals were never hashed. Nine experiments matching across every sub-figure makes a material difference very unlikely.

CAVEAT-2: This audit re-ran experiments; it did not re-audit methodology. G1 (post-hoc sizing replay assumes per-lot P&L is independent of position size) applies unchanged to EXP-0015, 0016 and 0017, and still makes projections beyond 15-20 lots directional rather than precise.
CAVEAT-3: EXP-0013's known verdict-logic bug (HANDOFF G6) was not fixed and the script was not re-run with a correction; the bucket P&L figures used here are unaffected by it.
next_steps: EXP-0020 (PROPOSED): quantify the cost of the tax-withholding HWM artifact per FINDING-3. Needs section 13 approval.

DECISION-010 remains the blocker for TASK-1: the validated sizing (30% deployment, 20-35 lots) exceeds config/risk.yaml (25%, hard_cap_lots 10), so the ₹49.2L projection does not describe the system as configured.
Correct the EXP-0016 figures in ASTRA_STATUS.md's capital-goal table or retract it, now that FINDING-1 has settled which record is right.
